description: This is a PHP source file defining the Currency class within the Opencart ull namespace, which provides an API endpoint for handling currency localization in OpenCart. It includes methods for setting and retrieving currency information, handling HTTP requests, and returning JSON responses.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A controller class for the currency API, extending the base Controller class in OpenCart's system engine, providing an endpoint to set and get currency data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the API request to update or retrieve currency information, expecting a POST parameter named 'currency'. It loads language strings, models, validates the currency code, updates session data, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.
